We need understand Atomic: expresses requirement for exactly one feature. Violation when story combines two or more independently implementable, testable, or prioritizable features. Do not flag conjunctions that merely enumerate attributes of one feature.

Need evaluate each story. We have full backlog. Need decide. Many stories have "and" but could be one feature with multiple attributes. We need classify violation only for multiple features. Need evidence and rationale concise. Confidence high/moderate/low. related_story_ids empty unless set-level? This is individual-level, so likely empty.

We need provide exactly 69 objects. Let's parse each.

BC-001: "As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of sponsors, so that I can thank all the awesome sponsors." Single feature view list sponsors. No violation.

BC-002: view list user profiles. Single. No.

BC-004: attendee want clear map where buildings and rooms are. Single feature map. No.

This is suspicious: "edit my training node myself ... and links to slides." It combines editing training node and links to slides? Need parse. It says "I want to edit my training node myself, so that ... and links to slides." Could be two features: edit training node and links to slides. Independently implementable? Link to slides maybe attribute of training node? Hmm. The story phrase "and links to slides" after so that. Could be desire to link slides? Need decide. Atomic: "I want to edit my training node myself ... and links to slides" combines edit training node and (maybe add/manage) links to slides. Are these independently implementable/testable? "links to slides" is unclear but likely separate feature. However maybe "edit training node" includes links to slides as attribute? Need not overflag. Let's note.
